# Discord Moderation Bot

A complete Discord moderation bot built with discord.py featuring ban, kick, mute, warn, and other moderation commands.

## Project Structure

- `main.py` - Bot entry point and command loader
- `config.py` - Configuration settings
- `cogs/` - Moderation command cogs
- `utils/` - Helper modules for permissions and database
- `requirements.txt` - Python dependencies
- `.env` - Environment variables (Discord token)

## Features

- User moderation (ban, kick, mute, unmute)
- Warning system with persistent storage
- Case tracking for moderation actions
- Permission-based commands
- Embed-based responses
- Auto-moderation features
